Class ServerRegistry

java.lang.Object
mesos.server.ServerRegistry
public class ServerRegistry extends Object
Central server-side registry. Responsibilities: - Tracks nick → VirtualView for all connected clients. - Stores the expected player count (set by the first login). - Holds the AtomicReference to the Controller (null until StartMessage creates it). - Broadcasts ServerMessage objects to all registered views.
